reason: OpenRouter balance reached zero during the moonshotai/kimi-k3 collection run, causing 402 Payment Required errors for the remaining estimation/conversion calls. is_retryable_error() correctly classified 402 as non-retryable within a single run (retrying immediately without funds would not help), so these executions were marked 'failed' after a single attempt without ever receiving a model response. Credits were topped up afterwards; resetting these stages to 'pending' lets run_experiment.py make the collection attempt that funding now allows. This does not re-collect any response that was actually received (protocol Sec. 5.6.3), since none of these calls ever got one.
